definitions.gloss: to get angry, to be angry
definitions.explanation: To experience or display anger. Can be directed at someone (に) or about something (を/に).
To express anger at someone, often a child or subordinate, in order to correct their behavior.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{怒|おこ}っています。
examples.notes: ている form for current state

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はすぐ{怒|おこ}る{人|ひと}です。
examples.english: He is a person who gets angry easily.

examples.japanese: そんなに{怒|おこ}らなくてもいいでしょう。
examples.english: There's no need to get so angry.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}がとても{怒|おこ}っていて、{話|はなし}をしてくれなくなったので、どうしたらいいか{分|わ}かりません。
examples.english: My friend is very angry and stopped talking to me, so I don't know what to do.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{怒|おこ}られた。
examples.english: I was scolded by the teacher.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{弟|おとうと}を{怒|おこ}りました。
examples.english: My father scolded my younger brother.

examples.japanese: また{怒|おこ}られると{思|おも}いました。
examples.english: I thought I would be scolded again.

examples.japanese: {遅|おく}れたから、{母|はは}に{怒|おこ}られるかもしれない。
examples.english: I might get scolded by my mother because I was late.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のとき、{悪|わる}いことをすると{親|おや}によく{怒|おこ}られたものです。
examples.english: When I was a child, I used to often get scolded by my parents when I did bad things.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive) for 'get angry'; can be {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) for 'scold.' No pair verb. Pattern: Xが{怒|おこ}る (X gets angry) or XがYを{怒|おこ}る (X scolds Y).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {怒|おこ}っている = 'is angry' (state, not 'is getting angry').

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{怒|おこ}っている (is angry - state)
・{怒|おこ}られる (be scolded - passive)
・{怒|おこ}らないで (don't get angry)
・すぐ{怒|おこ}る (get angry easily)

HOMOPHONE: Different from {起|お}こる (to happen/occur) which uses different kanji.
